url.title: URL
url.description: The URL to fetch for data

collection.title: Collection
collection.description: Name of the collection we want to extract items from.

bbox.title: Bounding Box
bbox.description: Bounding Box of the items we want to retrieve.

limit.title: Limit
limit.description: Maximum number of items to retrieve. Must be a number between 1 and 10 000.

split.title: Split by Feature
split.description: When true, instead of returning the full geojson, split the message into each feature.

query.title: Query
query.description: Separated list by `&` of properties we want to query.
